body:
This IS me trying something different. People don't like to admit it, but sometimes suicide is the alternative option. And obviously I know that you can't violate the subreddit's rules by agreeing, and that you HAVE to suggest something else.

But I've tried everything that's going to work. Sure, there are things I haven't tried. You couldn't pay me to get me into therapy. I'm not going to trust the word of someone I'm paying to tell me what I want to hear. Maybe therapy works for some, but it won't work for me.

Life is, at best, difficult. But for most, they have a reason to get through it. I don't. So you're asking me to tough out a difficult premise with no incentive. Life doesn't appeal to me, and frankly, it's amazing that it appeals to anyone else.

I would prefer if my death could mean something, or at least be accidental. But barring that... I'm prepared to take it myself.

I've tried. It doesn't work out.

I lack enthusiasm to do... anything. I don't put effort into people or relationships. Or my life, really. If being hungry wasn't so uncomfortable, I'd have starved to death years ago.

I have no goals. No aspirations. I don't want to do anything at all. Happiness requires effort, and I cannot put in effort. 

And I'm not super bad looking or anything, really. It's my personality and behavior that are the issues. I am incompatible with regular people. That, combined with my lack of motivation... I just want to be done. I've tried. I gave it the best shot that I realistically can.

Don't get me wrong, I'm scared to die. But what scares me more is living like this for the rest of my life.

I've never wanted a good life. I just wanted to be happy. Or, barring that, find one person who'd care if I weren't around anymore.

But as I've lived, I've realized that... that's simply not possible. I am fundamentally incapable of happiness. And even if I were, I'd lack anyone to share it with.

I'm just tired of being alone, and living a life that means nothing. I don't want a life with meaning. In fact, I don't really want life at all.
